notes.title: Tragala now available
notes.content:
Tragala is now available on Steam!

This project is a small authorial proposal that I hope you like it. 

Some features of the game:

[list]
[*] Tragala proposes the player to get into the skin of Kurt, a restless young man trying to escape from the house-system.
[*] The meta-game mode includes cinematics related to real situations, some of the poems I wrote about tragala, and a complementary ending to the classic mode.
[*] The proposal is full of humor. 
[/list]

More info: https://zoozobra.com/tragala/
